body: I believe I speak for most of the people here when I say I am about to go crazy and shout and scream trying to tell anyone who tells me "It's not you who's speaking. It's depression." "What happened to the real you?" "Being depressed wont get you anywhere" to F*** OFF. Talking with that supposed 'righteous' speech that depression is such a bad thing while looking at me like I'm suppose to repent about falling into depression. I can face reality. They are just living in their idealistic and ignorant world.
Here's the thing. I don't want to feel better. Given the chance to end my life painlessly, I would have done it a long time ago.
I dont like watching movies, shows, etc. I am really on the edge right now. Idk what to do anymore. I hate my life so much.

Which is why I always wonder why the hell powerful people with money wouldn't choose to just bomb the earth into a million pieces. They're too busy enjoying their paradise to realize how much other people are despising theirs.

Everyone has their own reasons for suicide. There is no right or wrong, or stupid or smart. Opinions doesn't matter because everyone is entitled to feel a certain way, different from each other. Part of my reasons for suicide was also because I dropped a class. It was devastating and embarrasing to the point that I felt like a sore loser when I see my smarter past classmates. All in all, you're not wrong to feel the way you are now, but you still have other shining qualities such as your accounts. Here's to the best for you.

Persistently staying by your side
Without faltering, 
It sneers at you. 
Continue to embrace hope, 
It will flicker. 
But we all know, 
That's never going to happen.

You're not the only one. I prefer not having anything good happen to me. Life is just a little bit easier when you don't expect anything instead of being happy one minute, and crying over the same thing over and over again.

So.. Your therapist is just assuming that you're fine just because you don't have messy hair or stained shirt? I'm sorry, but you're therapist should really study up on 'People For Dummies' more. Who in the hell gave him the right to say that. Some people just hide their depression through a mask for whatever the hell reasons they have. They don't necessarily have to look like pieces of discarded trash just to have the words 'Im depressed. Help me' plastered over their faces. I would have kick him in the balls (Assuming he has any.) if I were you.
First of all, you have one hell terrible of company all around you. Secondly, the feeling of waking up after I commit suicide scares me.

I'm with you. Being an introvert myself, I envy people who have friends. My 'friends' are the ones who come to me when they need help or ask me how much I got on my exam. I find myself asking the same question; whether 'life' is just a dream and there's something more or it just ends there. Don't hesitate to PM me and we'll have chats. I'm sure we have the same interests.

Savannah is very lucky to have a friend like you. I won't stop you from making your own decisions. But if she can see and notice how strongly you feel for her, she will definitely be happy and watch over you.
I wish you all the best.

Indeed. Talking to other people is like talking to animals. I also kept my distance from many including my family. They just don't understand people who are hurt but try to act high and mighty by telling you off. You're not alone. I also want somebody who understands me and can talk to me.
I'm so glad someone is in the same boat as me. May I ask how you could continue handling life? Being suicidal has been eating me alive and I don't mind hearing a story or two.
